modified_from_paper.loss: L_IG divided by the image condition's own energy. The unnormalised form has a degenerate global minimum at 'erase the image': z_img -> 0 sends cond-base to zero exactly. Measured, see runs/ncf_ip2p/paper/.
modified_from_paper.library: official 150_20_hist.npy, 150 ADE20K classes x 20 palettes; Lab moments taken analytically from the histogram weights
modified_from_paper.statistics_support: support region only, weighted by the soft support
modified_from_paper.convergence: 200-step trace and 1000-step independent fixed bank; boundaries also measured; no pass threshold
modified_from_paper.region: region = the validated ATR clothing carrier (guided filter 4, MTCNN face boxes cut out, erode 3, feather 8 inward). Candidates are restricted to ADE20K class 'apparel', which restores the paper's per-class matching for a region whose class is already known, so no segmenter is needed and no compatibility gate is applied.
modified_from_paper.epsilon_lab: 5.0 Lab units, bounding the standard deviation the perturbation adds to each output channel, on top of the paper's raw box. The raw box alone is scale-blind: T0[0,0]=0.065 with epsilon=0.2 lets the luminance mapping flip sign.
